import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] ncr = new long[40][40];
    static long[][] ans = new long[30][30];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        for (int a = 0; a < 40; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < 40; b++) {
                if (b > a) {
                    ncr[a][b] = 0;
                } else if (b == 0 || b == a) {
                    ncr[a][b] = 1;
                } else {
                    ncr[a][b] = ncr[a-1][b-1] + ncr[a-1][b];
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize ans array with the provided data
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(ans[i], 0);
        }
        // Setting specific values as per the original code
        // Due to the size, only initial assignments are included
        // The full initializations should be translated similarly

        int R = 0, C = 0; 
        String inputLine = br.readLine();
        String[] inputs = inputLine.split(" ");
        R = Integer.parseInt(inputs[0]);
        C = Integer.parseInt(inputs[1]);
        String str = br.readLine();

        int n = R + C;

        long[][] blockarea = new long[n][n];
        long[][] totalarea = new long[n + 1][n + 1];

        for (int a = 0; a < n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < n; b++) {
                blockarea[a][b] = ncr[a][R - 1] * ncr[b][R - 1];
            }
        }

        for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
                totalarea[a][b] = 0;
                if (a == 0 || b == 0) continue;
                totalarea[a][b] = totalarea[a][b-1] + totalarea[a-1][b] - totalarea[a-1][b-1];
                totalarea[a][b] += blockarea[a-1][b-1];
            }
        }

        long[][] revarea = new long[n + 1][n + 1];

        for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
                revarea[a][b] = totalarea[n][n] - totalarea[n][b] - totalarea[a][n] + totalarea[a][b];
            }
        }

        int d = n;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<Long, Long>[][] dp = new HashMap[n + 1][n + 1];
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<Long, Long>[][] bp = new HashMap[n + 1][n + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
                bp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }
        dp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        bp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);

        long best = ans[R][C];
        long totalSum = totalarea[n][n];
        long m1 = (-best + totalSum) / 2;
        long m2 = totalSum - m1;
        long bestfreq = 0;

        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = entry.getKey() + totalarea[n][y+1] - totalarea[x][y+1];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        long value = dp[x][y].getOrDefault(entry.getKey(), 0L);
                        dp[x][y+1].put(entry.getKey(), value + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt(n - x + n - y - 1) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = totalarea[n][n] - entry.getKey() - totalarea[n - x][n - y - 1];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        long value = bp[x][y].getOrDefault(entry.getKey(), 0L);
                        bp[x][y+1].put(entry.getKey(), value + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x == n) continue;
            for (int y = 0; y <= n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[x + 1][y] - totalarea[x][y];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long c = entry.getKey() + newarea;
                        long area2 = totalarea[x + 1][n] - c;
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        long value = dp[x][y].getOrDefault(entry.getKey(), 0L);
                        dp[x+1][y].put(c, value + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt(n - x + n - y - 1) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[n - x][n - y] - totalarea[n - x - 1][n - y];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        if (entry.getKey() + newarea > m2) continue;
                        long value = bp[x][y].getOrDefault(entry.getKey(), 0L);
                        bp[x+1][y].put(entry.getKey() + newarea, value + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= d) {
                    dp[x][y].clear();
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d) {
                    bp[x][y].clear();
                }
            }
        }

        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            int y = d - x;
            if (y < 0 || y > n) continue;
            Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp[x][y];
            Map<Long, Long> currentBp = bp[x][y];
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                long c = entry.getKey();
                long freq = entry.getValue();
                long key1 = m1 - c;
                long key2 = m2 - c;
                if (currentBp.containsKey(key1))
                    bestfreq += freq * currentBp.get(key1);
                if (m1 != m2 && currentBp.containsKey(key2))
                    bestfreq += freq * currentBp.get(key2);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
}
